cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Pre-filtered soft shadow maps using hardware trilinear mipmaps, anisotropic filtering, and separable Gaussian blurs
Explaining why overlapping blockers (z_A=2.0m, z_B=6.0m) inflate variance σ²=4.0m² and cause raw Chebyshev to leak 20.00%–39.02% light in umbra
Suppressing non-physical Chebyshev probability tails via Lauritzen smoothstep(p_min, 1.0, p_max) windowing
Replacing expensive 32-tap per-pixel PCF shadow loops with O(1) 2-channel (z, z²) moment lookups
not_for: Ray-traced hard pinhole shadows with zero penumbra filter radius
High-depth-complexity foliage stacks (> 4 overlapping layers) requiring 4-moment Moment Shadow Mapping (MSM) or Exponential VSM (EVSM)
Neural spatio-temporal ray-traced shadow denoisers (SVGF / ReLAX)
Unlit scenes without shadow-casting directional or spot lights
